explanation: Faithfully states Hegyvári's bound f(a,K) ≪ a·e^{O(K)} as quoted on erdosproblems.com/1213. There is an absolute C such that every strictly increasing integer sequence starting at a, with gaps ≤ K and last term exceeding C·a·e^{CK}, has two distinct nonempty index intervals with equal sums. Intervals are encoded as distinct pairs [u,v) ≠ [x,y), which is correct.
